separationOfConcerns.authoringHostExecutionAvailability: RESOLVED — the authoring host had no container runtime; a GitHub-hosted native amd64 runner did. The environmental blocker recorded in Attempt 1 is superseded for the purpose of running the experiment.
separationOfConcerns.candidateRuntimeModelCompatibility: NOT RESOLVED — the compatibility question remains open. Two harness-side defects, both authored here, sit between this run and an answer.
separationOfConcerns.note: These are deliberately separate axes. Attempt 2 answers the first and leaves the second open.

attempts.reason: No local container runtime: no docker/podman/nerdctl/finch/colima/limactl binary, and a stale /var/run/docker.sock with no daemon behind it.
attempts.notMadeFalseBy: Attempt 2. Attempt 1 remains a true statement about that host and is preserved byte-for-byte.

attempts.host: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest, native linux/amd64, no emulation
attempts.reason: All eight invocations ran, exited 0, and were deterministic, but no arm produced valid TSV because the probe mounted TESSDATA_PREFIX without Tesseract's configs directory, and the sentinel read 'LABEL LENS 14H' because the hand-built 9 glyph is ambiguous. Both defects are harness-side.

evidenceShortOfTheFrozenBar.interpretation: The float model was resident and produced output identical to the control's. This is consistent with compatibility and inconsistent with INCOMPATIBLE_FLOAT_MODEL, but it does not meet the frozen COMPATIBLE criteria, which require valid TSV and an exact sentinel transcript. The frozen bar governs.

claimsNotMade: No recognition-capability, accuracy, or CER claim.
No production-suitability, Render-performance, or production-determinism claim.
No authorization to replace Tesseract.js, change the production model or core, or deploy anything.
frozenCropBenchmarkReason: A governed frozen-crop benchmark requires a COMPATIBLE verdict plus its own preregistration. Neither exists.
requiredNextStep: A separately preregistered Attempt 3 that fixes both harness defects: make Tesseract's tsv config reachable (mount the stock tessdata configs, or use --tessdata-dir for the model while leaving TESSDATA_PREFIX on the packaged tree), and redesign the ambiguous 9 glyph. The frozen protocol forbids altering settings or inputs after a failure, so neither fix may be applied to this attempt.
performanceInterpretation: Latency (257-300 ms) and peak RSS (~38 MB control, ~61 MB treatment) are measurements for the GitHub-hosted native amd64 runner. They are diagnostic only and do not establish Render production performance.
